parameters.description_en: The ID of the consumer group. You can call the [QuerySubscribeRelation](~~170352~~) operation to query the consumer group ID in an AMQP subscription. You can also go to the IoT Platform console,and choose **Rules** > **Server-side Subscription** to view the consumer group ID.

>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
